summary: Plymouth-Canton Community Schools emphasizes the importance of E-Rate for maintaining affordable connectivity and network infrastructure in their suburban school district. They support maintaining the current eligibility scope for equipment and services and urge the FCC to keep educational programs, such as Pre-K and Head Start, included in the program. They also highlight the role of consultants in overseeing the program and the need to streamline and certify E-Rate forms. The school district expresses concern about the impact of funding cuts on their operations and recommends preserving the core E-Rate program and avoiding changes that would reduce access or increase administrative burden.

claims.argument: Cutting funding will force schools to use general fund dollars, which continue to shrink
claims.evidence_quote: If funding is cut, we will invariably have to make up the shortfall through general fund dollars, that continue to shrink.
